# Scenario: host bind mounts and non-volume types are rejected with
# security_violation; cycle soft-fails and prior containers stay running.
# README Strict Volume & Socket Control / Events.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: baseline without forbidden mounts'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

# --- Cycle 1: healthy stack ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-volpol-web

cd git-repo
cp ../compose.bind.yml dev/e2e-volpol/docker-compose.yml
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'fix: host bind mount'
cd ..

# --- Cycle 2: bind rejected; prior container untouched ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'security_violation'
stderr 'disallowed_bind_mount'
stderr 'volume policy violation'
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'done duration='

exists $HOME/.events
grep 'security_violation' $HOME/.events
grep 'disallowed_bind_mount' $HOME/.events
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-volpol-web

cd git-repo
cp ../compose.tmpfs.yml dev/e2e-volpol/docker-compose.yml
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'fix: tmpfs volume type'
cd ..

# --- Cycle 3: tmpfs rejected; prior container still untouched ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'security_violation'
stderr 'disallowed_volume_type'
stderr 'volume policy violation'
stderr 'WARN cycle finished with errors'
stderr 'done duration='

grep 'disallowed_volume_type' $HOME/.events
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-volpol-web

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-volpol
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9980
      target:
        service-name: web
        port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-volpol/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]

-- compose.bind.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]
    volumes:
      - /tmp:/data

-- compose.tmpfs.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=OK"]
    volumes:
      - type: tmpfs
        target: /tmp

-- .env --
